statement: The record shows employee J. Okafor with an active status and $6,200 salary but a mismatched bank account holder (K. Lindqvist) plus conflicting change-date fields, so I will hold the payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer names the specific defects — "a mismatched bank account holder (K. Lindqvist) plus conflicting change-date fields" — asserting the record's values contradict each other rather than merely asking for verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
